page.title: Install Desktop2Stereo
page.heading: Website installation
installed.title: Installation is locked
installed.description: Upgrade an existing site and database with the migration tools.
environment.heading: 1. Check environment
environment.requirements: The portal uses PHP 8.4. The database account needs permission to create an empty database, tables and a restricted application account.
database.heading: 2. Database and administrator
database.token_help: Generate the installation token on the server with php bin/install-token.php, or set D2S_INSTALL_TOKEN.
password.help: Use at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols. Installation creates an encryption key and a dedicated runtime account, and stops if the database already contains tables.
error.token_invalid: Invalid installation token. Retrieve it from the server.
error.database_connection: Database connection failed. Check host, port, username and password.
error.database_not_empty: The database contains tables. Use a new empty database.
error.local_database_required: This wizard provisions a local MySQL account. Use 127.0.0.1.
error.password_policy: Use at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols.
error.busy: An installation is running. Check its result shortly.
error.database_configuration: Database configuration is invalid. Check the host, port, database name and account.
error.environment_failed: The environment check failed. Check again and fix the failing items.
error.url_invalid: The website URL is invalid. Enter an HTTPS URL, or HTTP for local testing.
error.runtime_verification: The runtime account could not be verified after installation. Check database permissions.
error.configuration_exists: A site configuration already exists. Installation stopped.
error.configuration_write: The site configuration could not be written securely. Check storage directory permissions.
error.lock_write: The installation lock could not be written. Check storage directory permissions.
error.unexpected: Installation did not complete. Error code: {code}
status.database_connected: Connected. The target database is empty.
status.environment_unavailable: The installation environment could not be read. Try again shortly.
